sections.heading: Missile Detection
paragraphs: According to Al Jazeera, the UAE detected two missiles launched from Iran. Additionally, The Hindu reports that the UAE Defence Ministry stated Iran fired two ballistic missiles at its territory.

sections.heading: Official Alerts
paragraphs: Gulf Business reports that the UAE issued an alert for missile threats. This alert was issued after the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority (NCEMA) detected a threat.
